passiveBonuses.desc: Military School buildings automatically produce free units over time without player input. Higher-age schools produce more advanced units.
Villagers carry 20% more resources per trip. Traders generate 10% more gold per route.

age2.bonus: Generates a steady income of gold. Doubles the Military School unit production speed for all schools within 30 tiles.
All technology research speed increased by 20%. Reveals all enemy military buildings on the map for 60 seconds when built.

age3.bonus: All gunpowder units gain +20% attack damage. Unlocks unique Ottoman cannon upgrades unavailable elsewhere.
All naval units gain +2 armor. Acts as a coastal fort that fires large cannon shots at enemy ships.

age4.bonus: Military School production speed doubled globally. Produced units emerge fully upgraded to the current age.
Any technology can be researched instantly by paying 2x its normal cost. Acts as a University with no queue limit.

uniqueUnits.special: Bonus damage vs heavy armor. High reload time but exceptional accuracy. Can be trained for free via Military School over time.
Massive area damage against walls and buildings. Slow rate of fire but devastating impact. Bonus damage to gates and towers.
Fast heavy cavalry. Produced for free by Military School over time. Inspires nearby Ottoman infantry with +10% attack speed.

uniqueTech.effect: Military School produces units 25% faster. Units from Military School gain +5% HP bonus.
Great Bombard range increased by 2 and projectiles now pierce through thin walls, dealing damage to units behind.
All Ottoman military units gain +15% HP and can construct temporary field fortifications (palisade stakes) in combat.
